No change, and idea 213 is not minted. t02 (turning repeaters into a group that can negotiate and defend) holds T3-002 with T3-126 and T3-090 under rule 0 lines. Its concepts are: a member saying there is no coordination yet among the people repeating the grid to make them lay off (c0003, a carrying code of the A1 note); 'they're not groupmates yet as there's no group' (c0013); an Erase the Place member offering to negotiate if given the group's link, the venue asked and named as r/rainbowgrid (c0015, c0020, c0021); and a call to band together and prove organised to save the grid (c0031, c0032). Each part is held by a placed kind: calling people in to place (T3-002), saying who may speak for the placers or that no one can (T3-126), and the sub made around the grid (T3-090). What differs from other rooms is the room's condition, a pattern repeated by unorganised placers before any group existed, not a different doing; a kind for it would split T3-002 by how organised the called-in people already were, which is splitting by degree. With homestuck t11 (B1d-06, two logo attempts asked to work together, in T3-069), the idea is met in two rooms and carried by existing kinds in both. For B1e: T3-002's gate should say that calls to placers who are not yet a group are included, and T3-126's gate should say that saying no one can speak for the placers is included; c0003 is also a case for the T3-188 gate, a member telling an outside room that nobody controls the placers repeating the grid. The A1 note's carrying codes are carried: c0003 in t02's rule 0 line under T3-126; c0016 (a member claiming to have created the grid before the hive took it over) in t03's rule 0 line under T3-043; c0022 (Erase the Place's member calling the erasure retaliation for destroyed borders) in t05's rule 0 line under T3-087.
